title.narrative: Review of the Danish support to implementation of the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA): United Nation Economic Commission for Africa (ECA)

description.narrative:
The purpose of the review is to support the responsible unit, the Embassy of Denmark in Addis Ababa (EoD), in the management of the support provided for AfCFTA by assessing the progress of implementation and provide inputs for possible adjustments to current implementation. The review will emphasise the implementation of the ECA component with specific focus on lesson learned and recommendations on continuation of the component/programme. The review in adition to assessment of the implementation progress will assess development in the risks and assumptions highlighted in the theory of change. The analysis and findings of the review ill also feed into the formulation of APP V.
The objective of the midterm review (MTR) is to undertake an independent quality assurance of the implementation of the Danish support to implementation of AfCFTA through determining the progress in the implementation of the two components and assessing the results in relation to the projected targets. The assessment will focus on the ECA component, as the support to the AfCFTA Secretariat has not commenced. The review will be undertaken in accordance with the Danida Aid Management Guidelines, in particular Guidelines for Country Strategic Frameworks, Programmes and Projects . Denmark’s strategy for development cooperation, “The World We Share” will guide discussions on Danish priorities looking forward, in particular regarding the climate change agenda and adaptation.
